metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over Nassau County, New York lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: We need tropospheric NO₂ column data. Sentinel-5P / TROPOMI “NO2” tropospheric column (band: tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density) is the canonical product. - Collection: COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2 - Bands: tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density (mol/m²) - Location: Nassau County, NY (roughly 40.9 N, –73.4 W; a small county so a ~15 km box is plenty). - Periods: – 2018-10-01 → 2018-10-23 – 2019-10-01 → 2019-10-23 – 2021-10-01 → 2021-10-23 2. Masking / QA: The S5P L3 OFFL NO2 product is already cloud-screened (qa_value > 0.75 is recommended for strict filtering, but L3 is daily gridded median with built-in qa filter). We will simply apply the official quality mask band (qa_value) ≥ 0.75 to ensure only high-quality pixels are used. 3. Logic: Compute spatial mean for each year (mol/m²). If 2021 mean is strictly lower than both 2019 and 2018, answer “A: Yes”. - Check collection sizes first (could be zero for very recent dates) → C1 if any key period is empty. - After masking, use ee.Reducer.count() to ensure at least some valid pixels; if zero → C2. - If retrieved mean is None/NaN → C3. - Otherwise print concise stats and A/B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Area & dates nacoo = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-73.85, 40.55, -73.35, 40.95]) # Nassau Co bounding box d18 = ['2018-10-01', '2018-10-23'] d19 = ['2019-10-01', '2019-10-23'] d21 = ['2021-10-01', '2021-10-23'] def no2_mean(year_dates): col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select(['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density','qa_value']) .filterDate(year_dates[0], year_dates[1]) .filterBounds(nacoo)) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None masked = col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75))) comp = masked.mean().clip(nacoo) cnt = comp.select(0).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=nacoo, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo() if cnt['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'] == 0: return 'C2' mean_val = comp.select(0).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=nacoo, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo() return mean_val['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'] m18 = no2_mean(d18) m19 = no2_mean(d19) m21 = no2_mean(d21) if any(x is None for x in [m18, m19, m21]): print("One or more collections empty.") print("C1") elif 'C2' in [m18, m19, m21]: print("No valid pixels after qa mask.") print("C2") elif any(x is None or str(x)=='nan' for x in [m18, m19, m21]): print("C3") else: print(f"2018: {m18:.3e} mol/m2 | 2019: {m19:.3e} mol/m2 | 2021: {m21:.3e} mol/m2") if m21 < m19 and m21 < m18: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Area & dates
nacoo = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-73.85, 40.55, -73.35, 40.95])  # Nassau Co bounding box
d18 = ['2018-10-01', '2018-10-23']
d19 = ['2019-10-01', '2019-10-23']
d21 = ['2021-10-01', '2021-10-23']

def no2_mean(year_dates):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2')
             .select(['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density','qa_value'])
             .filterDate(year_dates[0], year_dates[1])
             .filterBounds(nacoo))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None
    masked = col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75)))
    comp = masked.mean().clip(nacoo)
    cnt = comp.select(0).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                                      geometry=nacoo, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()
    if cnt['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'] == 0:
        return 'C2'
    mean_val = comp.select(0).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                                           geometry=nacoo, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()
    return mean_val['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density']

m18 = no2_mean(d18)
m19 = no2_mean(d19)
m21 = no2_mean(d21)

if any(x is None for x in [m18, m19, m21]):
    print("One or more collections empty.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif 'C2' in [m18, m19, m21]:
    print("No valid pixels after qa mask.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif any(x is None or str(x)=='nan' for x in [m18, m19, m21]):
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print(f"2018: {m18:.3e} mol/m2 | 2019: {m19:.3e} mol/m2 | 2021: {m21:.3e} mol/m2")
    if m21 < m19 and m21 < m18:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
